name: grantfinder
title: grantfinder · every grant, tagged
description: A Claude agent that sweeps the web for grant programs and tags every one. Starts with open source and crypto: each lane (OSS foundations, corporate funds, security, public money, AI, fellowships, Ethereum & L2s, other L1s, Bitcoin & privacy, public goods, DeFi, ZK research) is one Claude Code run, spawned from orbit/claudecode's harness spec and fenced to WebSearch + WebFetch. Results merge by URL into one SQLite file, tagged by category, ecosystem, topic, mechanism, status and amount. Web app at /grantfinder.

app.docs: GET / (Accept: text/html) or /app -> src/app/index.html: search, tag filters, sweep progress

health.docs: Liveness, grant count, total agent spend, agent availability

tags.docs: Tag counts grouped by category, ecosystem, topic, mechanism, status, amount, other

runs.docs: ?sweep= -> agent runs with cost, counts and the searches/fetches they made

sweep.docs: GET = sweep in flight; POST {lanes?, category?, model?, budget?, concurrency?} starts one (spends the host's Claude account)

verify.docs: {id} -> re-read one grant's official page and refresh it
